s: concept café and creative space pairing specialty coffee with design
w: A minimalist café, concept store and creative space on Slovenska cesta in the city centre, roasting and serving specialty coffee alongside design objects. Opened in 2025, it has been singled out in European must-visit roundups as one of the region's most striking new coffee spaces.
_facts: Combines a specialty coffee bar with a concept/design shop
Featured in European specialty-coffee and design-shop guides
